plugin.description: Organize your stash, protect your inventory and customize your filters.
stashutility.tablet.auto_hide: Hide tablet indications when hovering an item
stashutility.tablet.auto_hide_help: Temporarily hides tablet colors and ranks when hovering an item in the stash, inventory or merchant, or when a game tooltip is detected. They return when the tooltip and hover end.
stashutility.tablet.manual_hide_help: Manual hiding takes priority. Tablet colors and ranks stay hidden until you click Show or restart GameHelper, even after moving the mouse.
stashutility.transfer.names_hint: Enter the exact tab and folder names. Leave the folder empty for a tab at the stash root. Names are not translated.
stashutility.transfer.pending: Use the sort icons on the inventory and the open stash tab. Each icon only sorts its own grid.
stashutility.sort.inventory_tooltip: Sort this inventory. Protected cells stay untouched.
stashutility.sort.stash_tooltip: Sort the open stash tab (normal or quad). Specialized slots are arranged automatically by the game.
stashutility.sort.specialized: Sorting supports normal and quad stash tabs. Specialized slots are arranged by the game.
stashutility.sort.unavailable: The grid could not be read safely.
stashutility.sort.cursor_unavailable: The item held by the cursor could not be checked.
stashutility.sort.cursor_busy: Put down the item held by the cursor before sorting.
stashutility.sort.needs_space: No safe arrangement could be found. Free some space or choose the compact mode.
stashutility.sort.preparing: Preparing sorting. Keep the grid open and leave the mouse still. Escape stops sorting.
stashutility.sort.held_item: An item is held by the cursor. Put it back in the grid.
stashutility.sort.not_acknowledged: The game did not confirm the move. Sorting stopped.
stashutility.sort.progress: Sorting: {0} move(s). Leave the mouse still; Escape stops sorting.
stashutility.transfer.equipment_hint: Equipment uses the destinations below. The correct folder and tab are opened before Ctrl+Click. Numbered tabs in the same folder are tried in order when an item cannot be deposited.
stashutility.transfer.unique_hint: Unique equipment uses its numbered tabs, then the overflow tab. Each unique tablet type can use its own selected stash tab. Unset types use the default unique-tablet destination. Fragment destinations also select the matching category and preserve the existing Boss/Map model blocks.
stashutility.transfer.rarity_unavailable: The equipment rarity could not be read. No click was sent for this item.
stashutility.transfer.complete_equipment: Finished: {0} stack(s) transferred, {1} protected, {2} could not be deposited, {3} equipment item(s) without a destination. Unrecognized item families stayed in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.equipment_target_c: The destination or inventory position changed before the click.
stashutility.transfer.equipment_navigati: The destination tab could not be opened in time.
stashutility.transfer.equipment_invalid_: The equipment destination contains too many folders or tabs.
stashutility.transfer.equipment_control_: The stash navigation control could not be identified.
stashutility.transfer.timelost_hint: Time-Lost jewels require their own destination. Without one, they stay in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_hint: Specialized items use the game's stash affinities, including newly looted items. No stash scan is needed. Configure the affinities in the game first.
stashutility.transfer.inventory_button_h: Use the Transfer to Stash button below your character inventory. Keep the stash open.
stashutility.transfer.button_move_hint: Unlock the position, then drag the move icon next to the transfer icon. Click the padlock to lock it again. X/Y offsets are in pixels from its default position.
stashutility.transfer.button_tooltip: Open your stash to transfer specialized items and equipment with a configured destination. Protected cells stay untouched. Leave the mouse still after clicking; Escape stops the transfer.
stashutility.transfer.protected_hint: Click cells to protect them. Red X = keep. The grid has the same orientation as your character inventory. Any item touching a protected cell stays in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_complete_: Finished: {0} stack(s) transferred, {1} protected, {2} unsuccessful Ctrl+Clicks. Equipment and unrecognized item families were left in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_release_f: A transfer key could not be released. Press and release Ctrl and Shift before trying again.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_unavailab: Finish the scan, then open your stash and character inventory in keyboard/mouse mode.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_waiting: Ready: close the GameHelper menu with {0} and focus the game to start. Keep the stash and inventory open. Escape or moving the mouse stops the transfer.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_stopped: Transfer stopped. {0} item stack(s) transferred, {1} left after an unsuccessful Ctrl+Click.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_preparing: Preparing transfer: the GameHelper menu will close automatically. Keep the stash and inventory open and leave the mouse still.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_starting: Starting transfer. Keep the stash and inventory open; leave the mouse still. Escape stops the transfer.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_window_ch: The game window moved or resized. Start the transfer again.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_menu_fail: Could not close the GameHelper menu. Close it before starting.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_focus_wai: The game could not be activated. Click in the game and start again.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_scan_acti: A stash scan is running. Finish it before transferring.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_panels_cl: The stash or character inventory is no longer visible.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_panels_ch: The stash or inventory changed. Start the transfer again.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_mouse_mov: The mouse moved. Leave it still during the transfer.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_target_ch: The item moved, its position could not be confirmed, or a mouse button/modifier key is being held.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_key_faile: Windows did not accept the Ctrl key press.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_click_fai: Windows did not accept the mouse click.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_cursor_fa: Windows could not move the cursor to the inventory item.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_progress: Transfer in progress: {0} stack(s) moved. Escape stops the transfer.
stashutility.transfer.affinity_complete: Finished: {0} item stack(s) transferred, {1} left after an unsuccessful Ctrl+Click. Equipment and unrecognized item families were left in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.select_subfolder: Select a subfolder to see its tabs.
stashutility.transfer.preview_hint: Simplified preview of the last scan: names and rarity, without game icons or exact slot positions.
stashutility.transfer.priority_hint: Numbered tabs in the same folder are used in numeric order: 1, 2, 3, and so on. The next tab is intended for items that do not fit in the previous one. Unnumbered tabs remain separate destinations.
stashutility.transfer.scan_hint: Open your stash, scan it, then select a folder and a tab below.
stashutility.transfer.scan_cancelled: Scan stopped. Destinations were not changed.
stashutility.transfer.scan_unavailable: Open your stash in keyboard/mouse mode before scanning.
stashutility.transfer.scan_progress: Reading loaded stash contents. Keep the stash open.
stashutility.transfer.scan_failed: Scan interrupted: the stash changed, closed, or could not be read. Destinations were not changed.
stashutility.transfer.scan_complete: Scan complete: {0} tab(s), {1} readable item(s), {2} item group(s) requiring a destination choice.
stashutility.transfer.scan_no_items: No readable items: this tab may be empty or not loaded. Open it, then scan again.
stashutility.transfer.dump_hint: To validate name detection, open your stash and export its UI, first at the root and then inside a folder. The export is saved to config/ui_tree_dump.txt.
stashutility.transfer.dump_unavailable: Open the stash in keyboard/mouse mode before exporting.
stashutility.transfer.dump_saved: Export saved to config/ui_tree_dump.txt. Copy it before the next export replaces it.
stashutility.transfer.dump_failed: Export failed. See the GameHelper log.
stashutility.transfer.layout_unavailable: Stash tab names are unavailable. Open the stash and try again.
stashutility.transfer.folder_not_found: Folder name not found or ambiguous: {0}
stashutility.transfer.destination_not_fo: Destination name not found or ambiguous: {0}
stashutility.transfer.enter_destination: Enter a tab name in the table before checking.
stashutility.show_in_bg: Show Overlay When Game in Background
stashutility.show_in_bg_tooltip: If checked, the waystone highlights will remain visible even when the game window is in the background.
stashutility.enable_debug_tooltip: Enables advanced debugging options, interactive explorer, and hovered item inspector.
stashutility.debug.path_indices_tooltip: Comma-separated indices starting from the LeftPanel root. Edit manually or click through the explorer.
stashutility.debug.custom_root_tooltip: Leave empty to use gameUi.LeftPanel.Address as root.
stashutility.debug.root_null: Root address is null. (Game UI not loaded?)
stashutility.debug.path_failed: Path resolution failed at index step {0}.
stashutility.debug.hover_active: Hover me to highlight active node in game
stashutility.debug.hover_all_children: Hover me to highlight all children bounds
stashutility.debug.hover_hint: Hover over a waystone in your Stash Tab to inspect it.
stashutility.enable_waystone_manager_too: Enables or disables highlighting of waystones.
stashutility.min_tier_tooltip: Minimum Waystone Tier to highlight (Normal rarity is always ignored if Hide Normal Waystones is checked).
stashutility.filter_bad_mods_only_on_hig: Only Filter Bad Mods on Criteria-Meeting Waystones
stashutility.filter_bad_mods_tooltip: When checked, bad mod filtering is only applied to waystones that already meet the Tier and other active numerical criteria.
stashutility.filter_great_explicit_mods: Filter Great Min Explicit Mods Count
stashutility.filter_great_max_explicit_m: Filter Great Max Explicit Mods Count
stashutility.enable_tablet_manager_toolt: Enables or disables highlighting of precursor/breach tablets.
stashutility.min_good_mods_to_ignore_bad: Min Good Mods To Ignore Bad
If a tablet has this many good mods, it will ignore any bad mods and still be highlighted as Good/Great.
stashutility.enable_merchant_purchase_to: When checked, waystones and tablets in the active merchant purchase panel tab will be highlighted based on your criteria.
stashutility.enable_jewel_manager_toolti: Enables or disables highlighting of Jewels in stash tabs.
stashutility.jewel.empty_group: No modifiers added to this group profile yet.
stashutility.tablet.god_tooltip: A God mod immediately flags the tablet as Good/Great, ignoring any Bad mods.
stashutility.transfer.scan_folder_limit: Too many nested folders or a repeated folder.
stashutility.transfer.scan_list_mismatch: The tab list has {0} entries and {1} content pages.
stashutility.transfer.scan_list_unavaila: The tab list or its content pages could not be read.
stashutility.transfer.scan_reset_hint: Clear detected tabs and saved destinations, then scan again. Inventory protections and other settings are kept.
stashutility.transfer.scan_tab_unavailab: The name or content page of tab {0} could not be read.
stashutility.ui.empty_hint: Scan your stash to display its folders and tabs here. Then choose where each item type belongs in Destinations.
stashutility.ui.protected_hint: Items touching a cell marked X stay in your inventory.

stashutility.filters.waystone_help: Choose wanted or unwanted modifiers. Numerical limits are optional.
stashutility.filters.tablet_help: Each tablet type has its own rules. A priority modifier that meets its minimum overrides unwanted modifiers.
stashutility.filters.jewel_help: Create profiles for each jewel type. Meeting one profile and its minimum rolls is enough to highlight a jewel.
stashutility.filters.all_waystone_help: Off: at least one wanted modifier. On: all wanted modifiers. Numerical limits still apply.
stashutility.filters.profile_summary: This profile requires {0} matching modifier(s); {1} rule(s) configured.
stashutility.filters.incomplete_profile: This profile cannot match yet: add wanted modifiers or reduce the required count.
stashutility.filters.search: Search a modifier in French or English…
stashutility.filters.no_results: No matching modifiers. Clear the search or show all rules.
stashutility.filters.roll_help: Minimum value to match. Base range: {0} to {1}. Drag, or Ctrl + click to enter a value.
stashutility.transfer.gem_skills: Skill and Spirit Gems (cut and uncut)
stashutility.transfer.gem_hint: Gems use three separate destinations at every level. Uniquely named Skills, Supports and Kalguuran tabs are recognized automatically. You can change these destinations or select None to keep these items in your inventory.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_route_missi: Some unique tablets stayed in your inventory. Choose a destination for their type, or a default unique-tablet destination.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_view_missin: Some unique tablets stayed in the inventory: their controls could not be identified. Open Fragment > Tablets > Unique Tablets and try again.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_block_unava: A Boss/Map tablet stayed in the inventory: its block is full or could not be identified safely. Keep the two Boss models on the left/right and the three Map models on the left/centre/right.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_source_unav: The unique tablet could not be read. It stayed in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_grid_unavai: The unique-tablet grid could not be read or matched to its inventory. The tablet stayed in the inventory.
stashutility.transfer.tablet_block_full: The block reserved for this unique-tablet model is full. Free a space or choose another destination for this tablet type.
stashutility.transfer.gem_sort_manual: Gem level sorting could not be confirmed. Select Gem Level in the gem stash’s Sort By control.
stashutility.sort.gem_levels_unavailable: Automatic Kalguuran sorting requires a readable level for every item. Uncut flux is supported; engraved Kalguuran gem levels are not readable yet.
stashutility.transfer.type_hint: Choose a different tab for each weapon type, or use the default Weapons destination. Shields, foci and quivers can share Secondary Weapons. None keeps that type in your inventory. Existing destinations are kept.
stashutility.transfer.complete_short_det: Some items stayed in the inventory. Details in StashUtility.
stashutility.transfer.scan_choices_hint: Open your stash and click Scan My Stash once to list all tabs. Existing destinations are kept.
stashutility.filters.rank_help: Four-mod classification: S1-S84, A1-A56, B1-B35, C1-C20, D1-D10, E1-E4 and F1. Number 1 is best within each grade. AND / OR filters control highlighting while keeping the rank visible. Unknown or incomplete data stays N/C. Your custom ranks and minimum rolls are preserved.
stashutility.filters.rank_one: Choose one rank. Uncheck it to ignore this mod.
stashutility.filters.tablet_rank_conditi: The four explicit modifiers determine the grade, independently of their order and minimum-roll thresholds. Highlight filters and the excellence arrow remain separate. Unknown ranks or missing mods give N/C (unclassified).
stashutility.filters.farm_preset_help: Apply the reference workbook's S to F ranks to all eight tablet types. E and F remain distinct. The workbook reserves S for one or two modifiers per type. Your minimum rolls and AND / OR profiles are retained.
stashutility.filters.farm_preset_apply: Apply workbook ranks to all 8 tablet types
stashutility.filters.farm_preset_apply_h: Replaces custom ranks with workbook ranks and selects all recognized modifiers. Keeps minimum rolls, AND / OR profiles and other settings. Later edits are preserved on restart.
stashutility.filters.farm_preset_sources: Sources: Fubgun (Mobalytics), Ortenrosse (Ritual), koni_pu3 (Expedition), Dslily (Delirium), MisoxShiru (Abyss), community Breach/Temple tests.
stashutility.meta.title: Reference workbook · individual modifiers S to F
stashutility.meta.editorial: Individual subranks come from the editorial workbook, not an official GGG or streamer tier list. Legacy combination grades remain separate.
stashutility.meta.create_hint: Create a profile and add conditions or groups. Empty groups never accept a tablet.
stashutility.meta.legacy: Legacy settings remain active below. Enable workbook filters to use the profiles above.
stashutility.meta.conditions: Specific modifier�Exact rank�Exact subrank�Minimum count�No rank below�
stashutility.meta.exact_count: Count this exact rank only (otherwise: this rank or better)
stashutility.meta.hover_hint: Hover a tablet in the stash, inventory or merchant, then open this tab. The last observed tablet is shown without changing game input.
stashutility.meta.copy_manual: Copy known modifiers to manual analysis
stashutility.meta.no_hover: No observed tablet for this type yet.
stashutility.meta.manual: Manual analysis / correction (does not alter the game)
stashutility.meta.uncertain_help: Unknown, duplicated, unreadable or excessive modifiers: no automatic keep/reject decision. Manual analysis remains available.
stashutility.meta.exported: Export saved in the plugin config folder. JSON can also be copied below.
stashutility.meta.export_failed: Export failed. Profiles remain saved in settings.
stashutility.meta.import: Import JSON (replace profiles for this type)
stashutility.meta.import_changed: Profiles imported from another catalogue revision: review the ranks.
stashutility.meta.import_failed: Import refused; current profiles are kept.
stashutility.meta.error.tablet-type: The tablet type does not match the profile.
stashutility.meta.error.tree-limit: Invalid, cyclic, excessively deep (32 levels) or large (256 conditions) tree.
stashutility.meta.error.empty-group: Add at least one condition to the empty group.
stashutility.meta.error.leaf-children: A simple condition cannot contain a group.
stashutility.meta.error.modifier: The selected modifier is unavailable or inactive for this tablet type.
stashutility.meta.error.subrank: The selected subrank does not exist for this tablet type.
stashutility.meta.error.count: Minimum count must be between 1 and 4.
stashutility.meta.error.import-schema: Invalid format, version, type or profile identifiers.
stashutility.meta.error.import-rule: An imported rule is invalid or belongs to another type.
stashutility.meta.error.import-active-pr: The active profile is missing from the import.
stashutility.meta.actions_help: Keep displays the result. Signal adds an amber alert. Ignore hides the indication.
stashutility.meta.rank_order: Individual ranks: S > A > B > C > D > E > F. Within a rank, 1 is best. These are the exact workbook ranks.
stashutility.meta.mode_workbook: Active filter: AND / OR profile. Select a profile in Rules; Analysis explains each decision. The tablet keeps its rank alongside the filter result.
stashutility.meta.mode_legacy: Active filter: modifier selection. S to F ranks remain available. Create a profile in Rules and enable the checkbox above to apply AND / OR conditions.
stashutility.meta.legacy_settings: Modifier and tablet ranks (S to F)
stashutility.meta.rank_and_rules: The tablet keeps its S to F combination rank. AND / OR rules choose which tablets to highlight. Add nested groups, for example (S1 AND A1) OR (S1 AND B1).
stashutility.meta.fubgun_rule: At least 2 additional random map modifiers AND (monster effectiveness OR increased number of rare monsters). The minimum roll is checked automatically, as recommended by Fubgun.
stashutility.meta.rank_settings: Choose modifier ranks · S to F
stashutility.meta.error.minimum-roll: Invalid minimum roll for this condition
stashutility.meta.rules_help: Create or select a profile, add conditions, then choose AND or OR for each group. Only this tablet type is affected. Empty groups must be completed before the profile can accept a tablet.
stashutility.meta.show_both: Show both French and English texts
